attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees receiving an original, reinstated or reactivated license during the cycle accrue 1.66 PDH per month (or part) licensed.
rules.alternatives: Deem Status for participants in a qualifying Colorado state department professional development program; active-duty military exemption.
rules.audit_note: Audits are conducted after the renewal period ends; keep CPD documentation (rubric/survey, Learning Plan, PDA records) for 5 years from the license expiration date.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved Professional Development Activities: volunteer service, consultation, supervision, presenting, coursework, publication, independent learning; coursework from an accredited educational institution or nationally/regionally recognized professional organization may count for all 40 PDH
rules.carryover: Up to 5 PDH earned within 6 months before expiration and above the 40 may be carried to the next cycle.
rules.notes: Continuing Professional Development program: complete the Professional Practice Rubric and self-assessment, a Learning Plan, then 40 PDH. Max 20 PDH per single activity type (except qualifying coursework). No mandated subjects found in the rule. Licenses expire Aug 31 of odd-numbered years.
rules.rule_quote: Accrue 40 Professional Development Hours (PDH) in line with your Learning Plan and retain documentation of the completed activities.
